notes: Areas are water within a lake's outline (buffered 200 m) or, without one, a search circle (1 km unless the lake sets a smaller one), by method D17 (Lee-filtered HH at least 3 dB below the window median); wet shore and sediment flats read as water, so a lake drawing down onto them barely changes its radar area; images are crops on the UTM grid, north up; they are pictures, not map overlays.

method.water: valid and HH at least 3 dB below the window-median HH, after a 7x7 Lee filter (ENL 4) on linear HH power; HV is not used for water
method.zone: the mapped outline buffered 200 m, or a circle around the lake point; no shadow rule inside it
method.window: the cache keeps each pass cropped to the zone plus 1500 m on every side, with the window statistics (medians, dark share) of its full 6 km search window, measured before the crop; areas and screens use those
method.window_statistics: the window-median HH leaves out radar layover and shadow from the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM (look azimuth 255 degrees ascending, 105 descending, incidence 40 degrees)
method.screens: as before: window-median HH within 3 dB of its track, robust outliers (|z| > 3.5) in the window dark share (HH and HV, 3x3 boxcar) and median HV, and the hand list
method.noise: per track: 1.4826 x the median pass-to-pass difference of up to 8 earlier valid passes, at least max(0.005 km2, 2% of the baseline)
method.baseline: median of up to 6 earlier valid passes on the same track

levels.Alert: growing: two valid passes in a row, on any tracks, with z >= +2; neither a track's first pass on a processing version its baseline lacks, nor flagged frozen, nor one of the first 2 passes per track after the lake opened
levels.Watch: one valid pass with |z| >= 2, or a CUSUM over the z values (k = 0.5) reaching 4
levels.Decrease noted: the two-pass rule with z <= -2; information only, never an Alert

method.not_measurable: no level when under 50% of the zone is observable or the lake's Sentinel-2 check (lakes-check) has IoU under 0.4
method.study: method study of 11 Nov 2026 (38 radar-optical pairs at Attabad, Passu, Karambar and Shazore)
